title: The lead can't be changed on Invoiced, Paid or Imported work orders
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in on the Work Orders build under test with Work Orders view permission and Work Orders create-and-edit; the Board View and Tech View display options are on.
  2. The current location has at least 3 lead technicians shown as groups/columns (a technician is eligible when they are Clockable, Active, and their role is not Office or Time Clock User).
  3. Via New Work Order, create several work orders and set a Lead Technician on each, spread across the technicians with some left Unassigned; then open the Work Orders page.
  4. Work orders in Invoiced, Paid, Declined, and Imported status.
custom_steps:
1. Try to reassign an Invoiced work order from the dialog, from drag, and from List more-actions; confirm each is blocked.
  2. Repeat for Paid, Declined, Imported.
  3. With engineering/dev support, send a lead-change request for one of these directly to the endpoint (bypassing the UI) and confirm it is refused.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The lead technician cannot be changed in Invoiced, Paid, or Imported status by any path, including a request that bypasses the UI (server-refused).
  • An Invoiced or Paid work order can still be dragged to reorder within its current technician (or within Unassigned), but cannot move to another technician, to Unassigned, or out of Unassigned; Declined and Complete move freely.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043 (Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options). Story reference: SV-10047 — Reassign or unassign the lead technician. Spec: Confluence page 845185030 “Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options”, PRD v33 (2026-09-28), requirement(s) S4-R10, S4-N2 (read 30 Sep 2026). Review decisions/answers: Confluence page 853901313 where cited. Source-verified on 30 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S4-R10: “Enforce the prohibited-status rule in S4-N2 on every lead-change path, including requests that bypass interface controls.”
  • S4-N2: “Do not allow the lead technician to change in Invoiced, Paid, or Imported status. An Invoiced or Paid work order can still be dragged to reorder it within its current technician (or within Unassigned), but it cannot be moved to another technician, to Unassigned, or out of Unassigned. Declined and Complete work orders can be moved freely, as today.”
